subject: Retainer forecast reconciliation + CS cadence
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Cho <amanda@brightline.health>, procurement@brightline.health
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Retainer forecast reconciliation + CS cadence

Amanda — looping you in as we consolidate July forecast for your upcoming retainer expansion. Finance needs a quick reconciliation of stages so we can bake Q3/Q4 numbers into the board forecast. Can you confirm the current expected timing and probability for each line below? I attached the raw workbook with our working numbers.

Opportunity summary (from our notes):
- Pilot -> Retainer: $120,000 (pilot currently in execution)
- Add-on capacity pool: $75,000 (negotiating scope)
- Seat expansion (clinical seats): $30,000

Ask: please reply with the expected close month and a confidence percentage for each line (e.g., Aug / 60%). If procurement has a runway, flag the procurement ETA as well — that impacts when Finance recognizes revenue.

Proposed next step: 30-minute cadence with CS and Finance to lock the mutual action plan before we push numbers to the forecast. Are you available this week for a quick sync?

Attachments: retainer-forecast-raw.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Amanda Cho <amanda@brightline.health>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightline.health
Date: 2026-07-21T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retainer forecast reconciliation + CS cadence

Monica — thanks for the summary and the workbook. Quick answers below and I attached a short internal roadmap so you can see our approval windows.

Pilot -> Retainer ($120k)
- Expected close: September 2026
- Confidence: 80% (positive exec feedback after pilot checkpoint)
- Procurement note: procurement loop will engage once legal has the SOW; they estimate formal review complete by Aug 10.

Add-on capacity pool ($75k)
- Expected close: October 2026
- Confidence: 50% (still scope confirmation with ops)

Seat expansion ($30k)
- Expected close: August 2026
- Confidence: 60% (budget approved at business unit level; waiting on final headcount confirmation)

We can do a 30-minute sync — Thursday looks best for our team. I attached our decision roadmap (Brightline-Decision-Roadmap.pdf). Once you send an updated MAP and SOW we’ll fast-track legal + procurement.

Thanks,
Amanda Cho
Director, Clinical Ops | Brightline Health
amanda@brightline.health
Attachment: Brightline-Decision-Roadmap.pdf

Subject: Re: Retainer forecast reconciliation + CS cadence

Amanda — perfect, thanks for the clarity.

I booked 30 minutes for Thursday, Jul 23 at 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite should be in your inbox). Agenda: confirm final MAP items, agree on SOW delivery date, and lock the CRM stages so Finance can accept the numbers.

I’m attaching the working MAP draft (MAP_v1.docx) — please add any delivery dates you need and we’ll publish a version for legal.

Quick internal note: Karthik / Marcus — please review the workbook before the call and make any adjustments to ARR recognition assumptions. If we’re comfortable with Amanda’s dates, we should reflect Pilot->Retainer at 80% for Sep in the board forecast.

Attachments: MAP_v1.docx

Cheers,
Monica

- Pilot -> Retainer set to 80% for Sep 2026 ($120k)

Amanda — thanks for moving quickly on this. We’ll take ownership of the onboarding plan once the SOW is counter-signed. Priya will be the assigned CSM for this expansion. High level next steps from CS: 
- CS to publish final MAP after the call tomorrow and send to legal.
- Target kickoff: week of Sep 7, 2026 (contingent on signed SOW).
- Estimated onboarding duration: ~6 weeks (standard clinical integration + training).
- I’ll update task list in HubSpot and set a kickoff placeholder meeting.

Amanda / procurement team — please confirm if you need any additional procurement paperwork or if we should route the SOW through your DocuSign instance. We’ll attach a signed SOW stub here once available.

See you on the call tomorrow 10:00 AM PT.
